body.p: A flying squirrel is shaking a soft bag. "What are the women doing?" "They are lulling [the child]". "How many children do you[KAY]: In the original Russian sentence the word 'Ð·ÑÐ±ÐºÐ°' means 'cradle'. have?" "Ten!" "Give the tenth one!" "I won't!" "Now I'll chop you!" "What did the flying squirrel do?" "It sways the soft bag!" "What are the women doing?" "They are lulling [the child]!" "How many children do you have?" "Nine!" "Give the ninth one!" "I won't!" "Now I'll chop you!" "What has the flying squirrel done?" "It sways the soft bag!" "What are the women doing?" "They are lulling [the child]!" "How many children do you have?" "Eight!" "Give the eighth one!" "I won't!" "Now I'll chop you!" "What did the flying squirrel do?" "It sways the soft bag!" "What are the women doing?" "She(?) is lulling [the child]!" "How many children do you have?" "Six!" "Give the sixth one!" "I won't!" "Now I'll chop you!" "What has the flying squirrel done?" "It sways the soft bag!" "What are the women doing?" "They are lulling [the child]!" "How many children do you have?" "Seven!" "Give the seven[th] one!" "I won't!" "Now I'll chop you!" "What has the flying squirrel done?" "It sways the soft bag!" "What have the women done?" "She(?) is lulling [the child]!" "How many children do you have?" "Five!" "Give the fif[th] one!" "I won't!" "Now I'll chop you!" "What has the flying squirrel done?" "It sways the soft bag!" "What are the women doing?" "They are lulling [the child]!" "How many children do you have?" "Four!" "Give the fourth one!" "I won't!" "Now I'll chop you!" "What has the flying squirrel done?" "It sways the soft bag!" "What are the women doing?" "She(?) is lulling [the child]!" "How many children do you have?" "Three!" "Give the third one!" "I won't!" "Now I'll chop you!" "What [DCh]: Suffix forming ordinal numerals is lacking.has the flying squirrel done?" "It sways the soft bag!" "What are the women doing?" "She(?) is lulling [the child]!" "How many children do you have?" "Two!" "Give the second one!" "I won't!" "Now I'll chop you!" "What has the flying squirrel done?" "It sways the soft bag!" "What did the women do?" "She(?) is lulling [the child]!" "How many children do you have?" "One!" "Give it!" "I won't!" "Now I'll chop you!" The wolverine goes off. "What has the flying squirrel done?" "It sways the soft bag!" A fox is coming. The flying squirrel is crying. The fox says: "Why are you crying?" "My children were taken away by the wolverine!" "Flying squirrel, how did the wolverine use to say?" "It used to say: "Now I'll chop you! If you don't give, I'll chop you, if you don't give!""
